sources_add.title: Lok Shakti Abhiyan et. al. vs ABP

fields_add.outcome: In March 2013, after meetings facilitated by the Dutch contact point on the complaint Lok Shakti Abhiyan et. al. vs ABP, a joint final statement was issued in which ABP and its asset manager APG committed to exercise their leverage to bring POSCO's business practices in line with international standards (OECD Watch).

fields_add.outcome: On 27 May 2013, on the complaint Lok Shakti Abhiyan et.al vs Norwegian Government Pension Fund – Global, the Norwegian contact point concluded that NBIM was in violation of the OECD Guidelines for refusing to cooperate with it and for lacking a strategy on how to address human rights risks related to companies in which it invests (OECD Watch).

fields_add.outcome: Spain's contact point concluded the complaint Alianza por la Solidaridad v. Grupo ACS-COBRA with a final statement that ACS, in its role of contractor, was not exempted from the OECD Guidelines' requirements, and recommended that ACS redress any damage that its failure to conduct adequate due diligence may have caused to the communities (OECD Watch).

corrections: Rewrote fields_add: the writer had the Dutch contact point facilitating the joint final statement, while the harvested outcome says it facilitated several meetings and that the statement was then issued. The sentence now says the statement was issued after meetings the contact point facilitated.

Checked the complaint_h flip from false to true and passed it: the case records four killed, a 7 March 2013 baton charge that injured 41 villagers, at least 105 betel vine farms destroyed and a threatened displacement of over 22,000 people.
check_log.note: First of three separate filings of the one 9 October 2012 complaint (Dutch, Norwegian and Korean contact points). I satisfied myself from the three harvested records that this is what the documents show: the allegations text is identical across all three, each gives the same filing date, each names the other two under 'Related complaints', and the shared outcome text opens 'The complaint was filed simultaneously at the Korean, Dutch and Norwegian NCPs.' The three are kept as three records with three links and three distinct cmp_keys, not merged. This one is the Dutch filing against ABP (st: agreement). Both this extend and the Norwegian one append a sentence to the same case's outcome; merge.py appends fields_add in order, so the two sentences will sit one after the other.

corrections: No correction. Upheld the writer's false_match: the complaint is a 2017 labour dispute over the dismissal of more than 3,000 PT Freeport Indonesia workers and their wages, employment status and medical care, and none of that appears in the case, whose events are the 1990 MIGA guarantee, the 1995 evictions from the Waa, Tsinga and Arwaa valleys, the killings ACFOA reported for 1994-95 and the Ajkwa tailings, with the case ending in 1996.
check_log.note: Borderline, and I say so deliberately: the complaint concerns the same company at the same mining operation and district as the case, so a later round could read test 1 the other way. I upheld the cut because identity on this map also rests on the dates and the event, and the case is built on the 1990-1996 MIGA-guaranteed expansion and its harms, 21 years before the dismissals. The writer's requeue note is sound: the 2017 dismissals look like a lead for a case of their own. The harvested 'affected' list for this complaint is polluted with OECD Watch's site navigation and cookie-banner text, which a later harvest should clean.
